# Bundled third-party files

These files are copied unmodified so that the AI detection works without internet access on the demo machine.

| File | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `tf.min.js` | [@tensorflow/tfjs 4.22.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tensorflow/tfjs) | Apache-2.0 |
| `coco-ssd.min.js` | [@tensorflow-models/coco-ssd 2.2.3](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tensorflow-models/coco-ssd) | Apache-2.0 |
| `../models/ssdlite_mobilenet_v2/*` | COCO-SSD Lite MobileNet v2 weights from `storage.googleapis.com/tfjs-models/savedmodel/ssdlite_mobilenet_v2/` | Apache-2.0 |
